segments.t: Lyova has come home and found Barinov asleep in his bed. He starts apologising, in a long, heartfelt speech. Listen to it in Russian first.
Лёва, закрой дверь, я уже сплю.
Я так боялся, что вы уйдёте.
Я не должен был вас выгонять.
Лёва, закрой дверь, я уже сплю.
'Lyova, close the door, I am already sleeping.' 'Zakroy' is the order 'close!'. 'Dver'' is feminine and has no ending, so it stays the same.
'Oh, Viktor Petrovich, you are home.' 'Doma' is 'at home', while 'domoy' is 'homewards'. English uses 'home' for both.
'Thank god.' Literally, 'glory to God', and Russians say it as we say 'thank heavens'. It's a standard phrase.
Я так боялся, что вы уйдёте.
'I was so afraid that you would leave.' After 'afraid that', Russian keeps the future and says 'that you will leave'. English shifts it to 'would'.
'I was very wrong.' 'Neprav' is 'prav', right, with 'ne' stuck on. Lyova is a man, so it has no ending; a woman would say 'neprava'.
Я не должен был вас выгонять.
'I should not have kicked you out.' 'Ne dolzhen byl', 'not obliged was', gives 'should not have'. 'Vygonyat' is the same 'drive out' verb as 'vygnal', in its imperfective form.
'We have known each other for thousands of years.' 'Acquainted' is a short form. After 'thousands', 'years' takes the special form 'let'.
'Anything can happen.' 'Vsyakoe' means 'all sorts', so 'all sorts can happen'. 'Mozhet sluchitsya' is 'can happen'.
'We just need to ask for forgiveness.' 'Poprosit proshcheniya': after 'ask for', 'proshchenie' takes the 'of' ending, 'proshcheniya'. 'Nado prosto', 'necessary just', is 'we just need to'.
'We need to forget this stupid story.' 'Duratskuyu' comes from 'durak', fool, and is the everyday word for 'stupid, silly'. 'Istoriya' is a story, but also an incident, a business.
'I ask for your forgiveness.' 'Proshu u vas proshcheniya' is literally 'I ask of you forgiveness'. It's the full, formal way to apologise.
'Viktor Petrovich, do you hear me?' 'Slyshite' is from 'slyshat', to hear. 'To listen' is 'slushat', one letter different, and easy to mix up. Here is the apology again, whole.
Лёва, закрой дверь, я уже сплю.
Я так боялся, что вы уйдёте.
Я не должен был вас выгонять.
Lyova has said everything he wanted to say. Barinov's answer comes in the next scene. Until then.

lines.fragment: Лева, закрой дверь, я сплю уже.
